purpose: Measure horizontal clearance at every sealed C08 causal-replay pose and localize all ineligible route segments before choosing a geometry or trajectory correction.

approval.scope: One complete 4773-pose, 3,436,560-horizontal-ray Gate-4 C08 clearance-only audit; zero inference, graph construction, training, C09/C10 and M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: After receiving the exact clearance-only audit proposal, data, ray count, exclusions and expected evidence, user replied 继续.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only research audit of sealed generated assets.

sampling.rule: Audit all exact sealed poses, without early stop, using 720 world-horizontal rays at 0.5-degree spacing from the frozen sensor origin; retain minimum hit, azimuth, edge/tunnel identity and merge consecutive clearance<0.8m frames.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher is generated; graph edge/tunnel identity is evaluator-only localization metadata.
teacher.valid_mask: Every frame must produce at least one finite nonnegative horizontal hit; clearance threshold remains frozen at 0.8m.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Audit only; no graph, inference or planning decision is produced.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only three C08 files are opened. C09/C10/M-TARE are identity-only forbidden sets and are not read.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D only, 3,436,560 horizontal rays; expected minutes; zero GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: 4773-row frame clearance CSV, per-world quantiles/counts and complete consecutive risk-segment manifests.
evidence.complete_visual_review: For each world, one complete XY/XZ risk map and one clearance-versus-route plot.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop on frozen-input drift, missing/nonfinite ray evidence, count mismatch, forbidden read or evidence loss; do not stop merely because clearance is below 0.8m, since measuring all such frames is the audit question.
